digestContracts.runtimeTopologyCandidateV1: HPTC V1 binds every semantic candidate and delta field; candidate_digest is derived
digestContracts.manifestProtocols: strict JSON is transport only; validated native values project to HPTC V1 semantic commitments
digestContracts.registeredNumericConversion: receipt binds immutable registry generation, registry digest, profile definitions, normalizer and arithmetic receipt

orderingContracts.RuntimeTopologyCandidateV1.deltas: set semantics represented as a strictly increasing StableId sequence; non-canonical order rejects
orderingContracts.RuntimeTopologyDeltaV1.related_module_id: set semantics represented as a strictly increasing StableId sequence; duplicate, self or non-canonical order rejects

candidateEvidence.sourceHead: candidate identity kind source-head; source SHA equals candidate SHA
candidateEvidence.syntheticMerge: candidate identity kind synthetic-merge; exact source and base SHAs are direct parents of the candidate
candidateEvidence.authoritativeReceipts: emitted only after truth, native and consumer outcomes pass and then independently pair-verified

nonClaims: No manifest contract executes randomness, inventories a host, drives a sensor or grants authority.
No JSON serialization byte sequence is used as a semantic digest.
No source-tree receipt may qualify a synthetic merge, and no synthetic-merge receipt may qualify a source tree.
Failure diagnostics are not qualification receipts.
Production activation, deployment qualification, operator acceptance and release are not claimed.
